_readme: The recurring (room x placement contract) pairs of the 269 spine maps — the templates that would rebuild them. A map is room x contract x cast; the first two repeat, the cast is the lesson and is nearly unique. `scatter` is the residual, not a pattern: it marks a map whose arrangement carries no contract.
